    ┃      tab              next panel: Builds, Stages, Tree               ┃    
    ┃      shift-tab        previous panel                                 ┃    
    ┃      1 2 3            focus Builds, Stages, Tree (on Home: open the  ┃    
    ┃      enter            drill in: a build's stages, expand a stage, op ┃    
    ┃      esc              back one level, close an overlay; from Stages  ┃    
    ┃HOME  enter            open the plan screen on the row's plan         ┃    
    ┃      s                next sort column                               ┃    
    ┃      :                command bar: :plans :presets :sets :projects : ┃    
    ┃VIEW  l                logs for the selection: a stage, a job, or fai ┃    
    ┃      a                all logs, not only failed; in the run form or  ┃    
    ┃      f                follow the jobs on the log screen              ┃    
    ┃      /                filter the focused list, or search the log     ┃    
    ┃      n N              next / previous match, or next failure with no ┃    
    ┃      r                refresh the focused panel                      ┃    
    ┃      t                the build tree of the selected build: every bu ┃    
    ┃      e                expand the current error                       ┃    
    ┃RUN   R                open the run form for the selection            ┃
